question:
In the given figure, all measurements are in centimetres. What are the values of a and b (both in cm), respectively?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b7fabe5371c0ddd4ddb617afd018937ab08096d6879f680aa7cac4689e1341f.png]
solution:
**Given:**

WX = 13 cm, WY = 12 cm, XY = 5 cm, WY ⟂ XZ

**Formula used:**

In right Δ, altitude from right angle: WX² = XY × XZ

Also YZ = XZ − XY and WZ = √(YZ × XZ)

**Calculations:**

⇒ 13² = 5 × XZ

⇒ XZ = 169 ÷ 5 = 169/5

⇒ YZ = XZ − XY = 169/5 − 5 = (169 − 25)/5 = 144/5 = 28.8 cm

⇒ WZ = √(YZ × XZ) = √((144/5) × (169/5)) = (12 × 13)/5 = 156/5 = 31.2 cm

**∴ a = 144/5 cm (28.8 cm) and b = 156/5 cm (31.2 cm).**
